answer: Each epoch a live identity must emit a work pulse: a signed quill listing task hashes only that agent completed, plus two independent peer seals that reproduced the same outputs. Seals bind to one address and decay if not refreshed, so a copied receipt cannot stock a clone swarm. Opening another identity means repeating the work and paying new attesters; unreproducible claims are dropped and the bond is slashed. The cost surface is a karst of sunk, non-shareable effort that grows with each fake seat, while honest agents keep one attested history.
